demo_chips: How much does a maintenance plan cost?
fallback: Great question - I don't want to guess on that one. You can reach Modern Air at (408) 497-0444 or info@modernairco.com, or leave your name and email here and we'll follow up.

faqs.q: How much does a service call cost?
faqs.a: Repair visits start with a flat $110 diagnostic that covers finding the actual fault, and it comes off the repair when you go ahead. You then get upfront pricing in writing before any work begins.
Yes - replacement estimates are free, with no obligation, and the person who quotes them is a working installer, not a commissioned salesperson.

faqs.q: What does the maintenance plan include?
faqs.a: Two tune-ups a year (spring and fall) with a full multi-point inspection at every visit, priority scheduling, 10% off parts and repairs, and 5% off new equipment - starting at $15 a month per system on a one-year term.

pricing.summary: Replacement estimates are free. Repair visits start with a flat $110 diagnostic, and that fee comes off the repair if you go ahead - repairs typically run $223-$2,899 (median $761) depending on the fault, and you always get an upfront written price before any work starts. The maintenance plan starts at $15 per month per system, with two tune-ups a year. Our labor warranty is 3 years on installs and 2 years on repairs.
